info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Diorite Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Diorite Battery Detail Management API enables users to create and manage detailed information about Diorite batteries within the catalog. This API facilitates the organization and classification of battery specifications, making it easier for consumers to access comprehensive data. Typical use cases include adding new battery types, updating specifications, and ensuring the catalog remains current with industry standards. Ideal for developers building inventory management systems or product information platforms.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create detailed information for a Diorite battery, providing essential specifications and characteristics that define its functionality and performance.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the Diorite battery operations. It includes all necessary parameters required for the operation to be processed successfully.

diorite_battery_id.description: The unique identifier for the Diorite battery.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person or entity that requested the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of Diorite batteries requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Diorite battery.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the Diorite battery.

supplier.description: Details of the supplier providing the Diorite battery.

CreateCatalogDioriteBatteryDetailRequest.description: Schema for the request body to create or update operations related to Diorite battery details.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the dimensions.

Dimensions.description: Schema representing the dimensions of a Diorite battery.

verified.description: Indicates whether the supplier has been verified.

Supplier.description: Schema containing supplier information for the Diorite battery.

email.description: The email address to reach out to the supplier.

phone.description: The phone number to contact the supplier.

Contact.description: Schema representing the contact information of a supplier.

CreateCatalogDioriteBatteryDetailRespons.title: Diorite Battery Operation Response

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: A unique identifier for the record generated by the operation.

processedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: The number of records matched during the operation.

pricing.description: The pricing details associated with the operation.

CreateCatalogDioriteBatteryDetailRespons.description: Response schema for the Diorite Battery operation which provides the status of the operation and relevant details.

Pricing.title: Pricing Details

net.description: The net amount for the operation.

currency.description: The currency in which the pricing is indicated.

taxIncluded.description: Indicates whether the net amount includes tax.

Pricing.description: Detailed pricing information including net amount, currency, and tax inclusion.

content-type.description: The media type of the resource returned in the response. This indicates the format of the content.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This value can be useful for performance monitoring.
